entry.text: 2024/11 – 2025/02 Assisted Senior Living Web Application
Technologies: Angular titi, Spring Boot, MySQL, Docker, Twilio, Firebase, Rasa, FastAPI

residents, guardians, doctors, and administrators.
Key Features:
User Role Management: Role-based access for residents, guardians, doctors, and
admins.
Scheduling & Event Management: Residents can book and manage daily activities,
events, and family visits.

based authorization for secure access.
